note: Resort on the south shore of Lost Land Lake, east of Hayward, with cabins, a bar & grill, sandy beach and boat launch. Mostly seasonal: about 7 of its 32 sites are sold by the night. --Claude

flags: DROP CANDIDATE (price gate): 'Full Hook-up Daily $50 - $55' - the top of the ordinary RV rate is $55, over $50. No Good Sam record, no member discount (only '2% DISCOUNT IF PAYING THROUGH VENMO' -> $53.90, still over), no gateway within 40 km. Google 4.9 (216), a listing shared by the resort, cabins and bar & grill; RV Life 4* $$.

LONG-STAY: 'Reel Livin' Resort offers 25 seasonal and 7 overnight campsites' - 7 of 32 sold by the night (22%). Passes the five tests (nightly rate posted, online booking, no lot sales); not iffy (posted rates, 216 reviews, counts posted). Note rewritten to say 'Mostly seasonal: about 7 of its 32 sites are sold by the night.' Resort also rents 10 cabins; the RV sites are a small part of it but are sold nightly online (reviewer may weigh the cabins-first rule).

WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview proposed (downgrade): on imagery the shore is lined with cabins, the lodge/bar and docks; the RV units sit in the pines behind them, nearest about 55-65 m from the water (around 46.0806,-91.1409), with cabins and trees between. The resort map (which would show where the 7 overnight sites are) was refused. Stored evidence 'front RV/trailer row at Lost Land Lake waterline w/ own docks' is not borne out by current imagery; 'lakeside campfires' is marketing. Could equally be not waterfront.
